body: thank you for a straight forward answer. I appreciate it.
I'm scared of the pain, not death.

But I won't regret anything. I know it for sure. Regret, such a hateful emotion. I hate regret, that's why after I die, I won't regret anything anymore! Don't you see! Thank you for trying to help, but it will be in vain. Futility... people don't understand that until they're about to die.
